captions.detailed: A flat, 3D-printable nut trap with a distinctive 'Princess Leia' silhouette. It features a central cylindrical ring with a C-shaped opening and an internal hexagonal cutout designed to hold a nut securely. Two rounded, elliptical tabs extend symmetrically from the sides to provide a larger flat surface area for gluing.
captions.instruction: Create a parametric, low-profile glue-on nut trap in OpenSCAD. The design should feature a central C-shaped jaw with an internal hexagonal nut cutout, flanked by two elliptical side tabs to increase the surface area for adhesive bonding.
captions.factory: The design is constructed using a union of two main modules: 'jaws' and 'CinnamonBuns'. The 'jaws' module uses a difference operator to subtract a custom 'hexagon' (built from rotated cubes) and rectangular cubes from a central cylinder to create the C-shaped opening. The 'CinnamonBuns' module positions two elliptical cylinders (created by scaling standard cylinders) on either side of the main body.
